title: I asked “what if Pac-Man had multiplayer?” and ended up making a 2D extraction game
author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
selftext:
Each house has two stashes. One’s bunk. Grab the real one, dodge the armed plug, and make it back to the car. Clear a block in story mode and you unlock Block Rivals: seven houses, one clock, first runner home wins.

It’s a browser game for now, built in Phaser with help from just about every AI model under the sun, haha. I’m also recording a bank of opponents using Jev, some beatable, some faster than me. Players race the finished runs, so there’s no live AI call during a match.

I’ve captured hundreds of full races across a growing set of courses and stash variations. My last week of Jev testing used about 17.6 million tokens for $0.67, which still feels ridiculous.

[Try Plug Run](https://plugrun.io). I’d love to hear whether the racing feels fun and whether you can beat the rival.
